Introduction

Tertullian, Latin in full Quintus Septimus Florens Tertullianus , (born c. 155/160, Carthage [now in Tunisia]—died after 220, Carthage) was an important early Christian theologian , polemicist, and moralist who, as the initiator of ecclesiastical Latin , was instrumental in shaping the vocabulary and thought of Western Christianity . He is one of the Latin Apologists of the 2nd century.
